projected_source_record.title: Enouia SourceRecord v1
projected_source_record.description: A stable evidence location. Role is data, not permission. Cross-field rules not expressible here (time precision, locator/kind pairing, created_at >= captured_at) are enforced by the Rust validator.

projected_attachment_record.title: Enouia AttachmentRecord v1
projected_attachment_record.description: Only 'present' carries a verified object hash. URLs are inert references, never fetched automatically.
